main_measure.name: mean unusual next-day fall on case bars, summed per day

statistic.name: t of the mean across days

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 100 case-days

supporting_check.name: mean unusual fall, |forecast| above median minus below median

decided_by: Mean unusual fall above 0 with t >= 2 and the high-|forecast| minus low-|forecast| difference above 0.
reading: The falling-agitated profile is taken from the recorded regime (its detector components are not recorded and their 365-bar lookback cannot be rebuilt inside a window) while the streak of exactly 1 is recomputed from closes (first two bars of each window left out); the supporting check splits individual cases strictly above and below the cases' median |forecast|, cases equal to it left out.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.008573 on the check folds against +0.0185 on every fold
